name: resistance band side walk
description: A lateral band walk that strengthens the outer hips and glutes.
instructions: Place a band around your thighs or ankles and stand with your feet hip width apart.
Bend your knees slightly into a quarter squat.
Step sideways with the lead foot, keeping tension on the band.
Bring the trailing foot in without letting the feet touch.
Take 10-15 steps one way, then walk back the other way.
